subject: general
question: On 9 August 2021, the Parliament had passed the Limited Liability Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2021. It amended the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Parliament passed the Limited Liability Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2021 on 9 August 2021.
 
• This bill amended the **Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008**.
 
• The amendments aimed to decriminalize several offenses under the act and introduce new concepts like small LLPs.
 
• These changes were intended to improve the ease of doing business for LLPs in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 was enacted to introduce and legally recognize the concept of LLPs in India.
 
• An LLP is a hybrid structure that combines the advantages of both a company and a partnership.
 
• It provides the benefit of limited liability to its partners while allowing them the flexibility of organizing their internal structure as a partnership.
 
• The 2021 amendment was part of the government's broader initiative to reform corporate laws and improve the business environment.
